levels.surface: محمد بن الحسن بن أحمد بن الوليد

notes: The text writes «عند مسعدة بن زياد», where «عن» is expected; read as «عن» (a probable typo). The text is kept as written.
The Prophet is the end of the chain and is not a link (rule 12); the father (أبيه) is the last link before him.
The Imam Sadiq is written after «عن» and stays a narrator (owner ruling 2).

fixes.reason: «عند» where the chain pattern needs «عن» before مسعدة بن زياد; the stored Arabic is not changed.
